messages:
Jordan: Quick question — console preflight just turned this minor header match into a hard error for a customer. error shows: "header_matcher.invalid-order" but no hint which header or why.
Mira: Ugh. I've seen that. Usually comes from mixing anchored and numbered weights in the same override group. The lint rule name is terrible.
Jordan: Example they pasted:
```yaml
routes:
  - id: checkout-v1
    match:
      path: /checkout
      headers:
        - name: x-tenant
          exact: acme
    overrides:
      headers:
        - name: x-tenant
          action: remove
        - name: x-customer
          action: add
          value: "acme-corp"
```
Jordan: Console shows red banner but when I hover on the field there is no inline explanation. Only the top toast says the lint failed.
Rahul: Sounds like our lint is doing a global pass and returning a single code. We should attach the lint result to the specific YAML path so the UI can show inline tooltips. Minimal change: include "path": "routes[0].overrides.headers[0]" in the lint payload.
Mira: Agreed. Also, instead of hard error, make it a warn-by-default and surface an explicit fix suggestion: e.g. "change to header-transform with indexed priority" or propose autofix.
Lin: Small UX note — console autosave is kicking in while users are trying the autofix dropdown. That leads to save -> preflight -> toast loop. We need debounce on preflight on autosave.
Jordan: +1 on debounce. Can we also show the lint rule doc inline? something like: "Why this failed" with a 1-liner and a link to docs or show the expected schema snippet.
Rahul: We can store a short help text in the lint schema registry. Example payload: \n```
{\n  code: "header_matcher.invalid-order",\n  message: "Mixed anchored & weighted header overrides",\n  help: "Use either anchored matches or explicit weights in an override block. See https://redwood.dev/docs/routing#header-overrides"\n  path: "routes[0].overrides.headers[0]"\n}
```
Rahul: (not real JSON, just illustrative)
Mira: +emoji:thinking: I care about the autofix UX — can the console show a one-click preview of the patched YAML before applying? so user can accept/reject.
Lin: Yes — preview pane already exists for yaml diff. Hook autofix to that. Button: "Preview autofix" -> shows diff -> "Apply & Save" or "Dismiss".
Jordan: Deploy-bot just posted CI & integration-linter run: deploy-bot: preflight-check failed on branch feature/route-lint. See logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/214365/789
Jordan: Can someone pick up the schema registry change + debounce patch? Not big, but customer blocker.
Mira: I'll file a quick PR for lint payload -> include path + help text. Will also add warn fallback. Assigning to me.
Rahul: I'll do debounce + console preview hook.
Lin: I'll add an e2e for autosave->preflight flakiness. Test will simulate quick edits + autosave and ensure only one preflight is submitted after 800ms idle.
Jordan: Awesome. Thanks everyone. Please drop PR links in this thread so I can keep the customer updated. :thumbsup:
Mira: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1428 (lint schema changes)
Rahul: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1430 (debounce + preview integration)
Lin: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1431 (e2e flake guard)
Jordan: Marking this resolved for the customer once PRs are merged and rollout is on staging.
